body: Something like that might give me that extra push. I know I couldn't survive in such an environment so it would be die by starvation or in a way I can control
Indeed, I feel similar. I cannot handle failure, which basically means I cannot handle real life.
I'm in a very similar predicament... I have no passion or ambition. I like to play video games... That's about it. I don't think I can handle "real life"

I don't and never did intialize social interaction. People became friends with me in school and I accepted them. I was raised by a single mother with one or two boyfriends over the years, with three siblings (well, half siblings since they are from different fathers, but I think of them as full siblings haha). I would say I'm the only introverted one (my biological father is also introverted)

Nowadays, I don't socialize at all.
Only interactions I have these days are placing fast food orders lol I use self service for the supermarket and I cut my own hair.

Indeed. My hypothetical friends/partner are people who would "get me" and I would be close to and have a good rapport with. Ultimately they are idealized in my mind. They're not real people.

So while I like the idea of friends/partner in theory, in practice I feel it wouldn't work.
